reader.requirement: An explicit or implicit CANCEL naming a program not called in this run unit, or called and at present cancelled (explicitly or by an INITIAL program's EXIT PROGRAM), takes no action and control passes to the next executable statement; at 85 this includes the run unit's main program, which was never called.

edition-consulted.switches: folds DialectBehavior.CancelRefusesEveryActiveProgram (active from 2002) into BoundCancel: false at 85

refusesEveryActiveProgram selects the GR5 active test: at 85 the never-called active MAIN program is GR8's no-action case instead of EC-PROGRAM-CANCEL-ACTIVE (kb/Work PB5241); every later step of CancelNode (GR8 test, GR4 cascade, implicit close, reset) is one arm for all editions

reader.edition-search: grep DialectBehavior/DialectLevel over ProgramTable.cs and CallBinder.BindCancel; the CalledSinceCancel predicate itself is edition-free.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: CANCEL of the active main program is GR8's no action at 85 and EC-PROGRAM-CANCEL-ACTIVE (abnormal termination) at 2023 (p8a at --std 2023: 'abnormal run-unit termination: CANCEL P8A: program is active'); the never-called and already-cancelled cases take the same arm

reader.notes: Node.CalledSinceCancel is set by CallProgram, left alone by ActivateMain, and cleared by CancelNode and EndInitialActivation; CancelNode returns at once when it is false. A name the caller cannot reach (ResolveVisible null) is also no action, a permissible result of violating GR3.

refuter.evidence: Probe E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/coderead-1985/out/refute-1985-201/src/q8.cob (run q8-001, --std 85): a separately compiled called program Q8S and a contained program Q8C each execute CANCEL "Q8M" naming the active, never-called main program; then the main cancels Q8C and Q8S (the latter through reference-modified W(3:3)) and calls Q8S again. Printed 'S1 / S AFTER CANCEL MAIN / M AFTER S MN=1 / C AFTER CANCEL MAIN / M AFTER CANCEL REFMOD / S1': both CANCELs of the uncalled main are no action with control to the next statement (main's MN kept), the ref-modified identifier names Q8S and cancels it (S1 again). The 85 arm (CancelNode's refusesEveryActiveProgram false: n.Active > (MainActive ? 1 : 0)) is what lets a CANCEL of the main from a callee through; GR5 at 85 forbids only a called program that has not executed EXIT PROGRAM. cite.py: OK §1985:X.5.3.4 GR8 'No action is taken when an explicit or implicit CANCEL statement is executed'.
